rightsNote:
Everything in the upper half of this page is written by icanspeak French and generated from this site's own data: the grammar topics, the flashcard sets and the reference lists. None of it is scanned, copied or taken in part from a coursebook, which is exactly why we can give it away. Every page of every file says where it comes from.

What is deliberately NOT here: books, audio and practice tests from publishers and exam bodies (coursebooks, DELF, DALF, TCF or TEF preparation books). We are not allowed to pass those on, not even for free and not even in class. The exam bodies publish free sample papers themselves, so we link to them where they are published, under “Official sample papers”. That is also where they stay up to date. icanspeak French is not affiliated with France Éducation international or the CCI Paris Île-de-France.

faq.q: Where can I download free French grammar PDFs?
faq.a: Here: one grammar book per level from A1 to C1 and one complete book, each with rules, tables, exercises and answers. They are free, with no account and no email address, and you may print them and share them in class.

faq.q: Which PDF is right for my level?
faq.a: If you are not sure, start with Grammar Start (A1–B1): the ten chapters you need first. Or take the free placement test on this site, which tells you your level. The word lists follow the same levels, A1 to C2.

faq.q: Are the PDFs really free? Can teachers use them in class?
faq.a: Yes. We wrote everything ourselves from this course's own material, so we can give it away. You may print the files and share them with your students. You may not sell them or publish them on other websites.

faq.q: Where can I find official sample papers for the DELF, DALF, TCF and TEF?
faq.a: The exam bodies publish them on their own websites: France Éducation international for the DELF, DALF and TCF, and the CCI Paris Île-de-France for the TEF. We do not copy them: we link to each page under “Official sample papers”, where they are always up to date.

faq.q: Do the grammar books have answers?
faq.a: Yes. Every exercise has lines to write on, and the answers are in a key (corrigé) at the back of the book. Each chapter also links to the same topic online, where your answers are checked right away.
